scope: VOKU On archive and continuous cue-sheet reader; operator dashboard excluded
preserved: year directory and synchronized time ring

browser.pageJump: direct input, invalid page feedback, numbered choices and next page
browser.zoom: selected sheet only; fit reset; synthetic two-touch component regression
browser.rotation: selected sheet only; four turns restore original; current page remains selected
browser.reloadResume: explicit resume restores saved page, relative position and scale
limitations: Physical iOS and Android hardware were not used; multi-touch is covered by the real component with synthetic touch events and geometry tests.
